text_block_list.text:
After training, while holding a review 
meeting—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, training lately hasn't been bad, but 
still...
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm so close to grasping 
something, and yet I just can't seem to 
reach it...

The moment Special Week said that, all the 
strength suddenly left her body――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...Wah-wah!? Where... are we—"
(Whooooosh~~......)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoaaa! Now we're on the track!? Jeez, 
I have no idea what's going on anymore—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
We're finally in the final stretch!! Still 
holding the lead is Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh?! No way, are we suddenly right 
before the goaaaaal~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With her rivals closing in, can she show 
her clutch tenacity, Special Weeek!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah...!! If you say something like that, 
I have no choice but to run, don't I?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Special Week!! She has 
brilliantly lived up to the crowd's 
expectationsーー!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race was this supposed to be, 
anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know, but... it was fun. It 
felt great right before the finish line, 
too—ah.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! I finally get it! The answer 
to what's been bothering me...!
(Whooooosh~~......)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Um, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, whaaat!? Everything's back to 
normal...!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly, listen to this! I 
figured something out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The timing to make my move before the 
finish line—it finally clicked for me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, maybe it's because I 
finally figured out what had been 
bothering me all this time――”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I feel like training is going to go even 
better than usual from now on!

Thanks to this realization, it felt as 
though new possibilities had opened up 
within Special Week herself.
